summary: Public landing, login/trade redirect, Fastify health, compiled vx CSS, Redis-backed OTC REST data, and OTC WebSocket were tested. All 10 automated API/page assertions passed; desktop/mobile landing flows passed, including CTAs, navigation, FAQ, cookie consent, responsiveness, and computed vx styles. Production build succeeds, but targeted lint and code review found quality/security issues.

minor.issue: The WebSocket works and delivers OTC snapshots, but client disconnects repeatedly leave 'Task exception was never retrieved' / ConnectionClosedError entries because proxy tasks are cancelled without being awaited/collected.

issues: Portuguese copy visibly omits diacritics in several prominent strings (for example 'opcoes', 'voce', 'execucao', 'Tres passos ate'), reducing polish.
Small disclaimer/supporting text using #3A4A5E or #5D6C80 on #060A11 has weak contrast for its 12–13px size.

action_items: Correct missing Portuguese accents in landing content and hardcoded copy, and improve contrast of small muted text.
Fix lint/type issues in the redesigned files and stop suppressing TypeScript build errors; Next 16 reports the next.config eslint option as unsupported.
Add visible error/retry states instead of silently swallowing Copy Trading API failures.
Fix WebSocket proxy task cleanup with awaited cancellation/gather(return_exceptions=True).
Change Fastify CORS origin validation from startsWith to exact parsed-origin matching.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/next.config.ts sets typescript.ignoreBuildErrors=true, and its eslint ignoreDuringBuilds key is unsupported by Next 16.2.6. The optimized build passes while targeted ESLint still reports errors in page.tsx, ContaPage.tsx, VerificacaoTab.tsx, and CopyPanel.tsx.
CopyPanel.load() uses an empty catch block, so API outages are misrepresented as an empty trader list with no user-facing error or retry path.
backend app.ts accepts origins with allowedOrigins.some(o => origin.startsWith(o)); a hostile origin prefixed by an allowed URL can pass. Compare normalized URL origins exactly.
ContaPage.tsx is 1,019 lines, above the 700-line maintainability threshold; split account, withdrawal, transactions, and operations tabs into focused modules.

Several redesigned controls are rendered as active buttons but have no handlers (for example support knowledge search/tips/live chat/draft/articles and copy filters/learn-more/become-trader), so they appear functional but do nothing.
seed_data_creation: None; only public read-only endpoints and pages were tested.
context_for_next_testing_agent: No credentials were needed or used. Public URL came from frontend/.env. Final pytest run: 10 passed. Redis PING returned PONG, 70 otc:* keys existed, 14 OTC assets were active, prices changed across ticks, candles validated, and public WSS delivered a snapshot. /trade correctly ended at /login for an unauthenticated user. Authenticated redesign flows remain untested by request.
rca_of_the_issue: Functional smoke coverage passes. Remaining defects are primarily quality and cleanup issues: build validation is intentionally suppressed, API errors are swallowed in CopyPanel, CORS uses prefix rather than exact-origin comparison, and the proxy does not retrieve completed WebSocket task exceptions after disconnect.
